description: Estimate the monthly repayment, total repaid and total interest on an Australian principal-and-interest home loan. Use this when someone asks what a loan would cost them each month, or how much interest they'd pay over the life of a loan. Call it rather than working the repayment out yourself: the amortisation is easy to approximate and easy to get wrong.

interestRate.description: Annual interest rate as a percentage, e.g. 6.2 for 6.2% p.a.

termYears.description: Loan term in years. Defaults to 30.

name: estimate_repayments

totalInterest.description: Total interest paid over the term, AUD.

totalRepaid.description: Total repaid over the full term, AUD.

title: Estimate home loan repayments
